title: The Hourglass Baby Ran Out of Time
caption:
Every second drained... then it turned to stone.
A tiny hourglass creature wedged between black stone gears: its golden sand runs out, it petrifies to gray rock, then cracks open in a gold-green burst of light.
Best watched at night on loop, with the sound on.
If you could rewind to any one day, which would you pick?
Save this little rebirth for your next midnight scroll.
